WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

3. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.

4. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

5. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.

6. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.

7. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

9. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

10. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.

11. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Design in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Occupational Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Emergency Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

8. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

12. A — Information and Communication Technology
